newsitem.title: CANADA: Kazakhstan Minerals posts drill results.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan Minerals posts drill results.

text.p: Kazakhstan Minerals Corp said on Wednesday that results from drilling at its gold and copper deposit in north Kazakhstan show an increase in near surface gold.
KazMinCo also said Wednesday it has extended its land holdings in the district by securing an exploration licence for an area of 525 square km.
Results from drilling at the Varvarinskoye deposit will be included in a pre-feasibility study scheduled for completed in the fourth quarter this year, the company said in a statement.
Grades from the recent testing showed gold ranging from 1.70 grams per tonne to 6.25 grams per tonne, and copper ranging from 0.20 percent to one hole with 7.93 percent.
The company said it has now completed 72 holes totalling 10,300 metres of diamond drilling.
